util

Enum OperatingSystem

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<OperatingSystem>
      • util.OperatingSystem
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<OperatingSystem>

    public enum OperatingSystem
extends java.lang.Enum<OperatingSystem>
    Defines supported operating systems and maps each enumeration constant to its display name, version number, and server/workstation classification.
    Since:
    10 February 2021
    Version:
    0.1
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs
    See Also:
    See source code java_props_md.c for actual Windows OS name strings

    • Method Detail

      • values

        public static OperatingSystem[] values()
        Returns an array containing the constants of this enum type, in the order they are declared. This method may be used to iterate over the constants as follows: 
        for (OperatingSystem c : OperatingSystem.values())
    System.out.println(c);
        Returns:
        an array containing the constants of this enum type, in the order they are declared

      • valueOf

        public static OperatingSystem valueOf(java.lang.String name)
        Returns the enum constant of this type with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this type. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
        Parameters:
        name - the name of the enum constant to be returned.
        Returns:
        the enum constant with the specified name
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if this enum type has no constant with the specified name
        java.lang.NullPointerException - if the argument is null

      • getRealName

        public java.lang.String getRealName()
        Returns the name of the Operating System mapped to by this named constant.
        Returns:
        real name of the Operating System

      • getVersion

        public double getVersion()
        Returns the version of the Operating System mapped to by this named constant.
        Returns:
        the Operating System version. Note, if the Operating System is not Windows, a value of zero will be returned. To get the current OS version for other OS types, use the SystemInfo static class

      • isServer

        public boolean isServer()
        Returns a boolean value that determines whether the computer system is a server or a workstation type.
        Returns:
        a true value represents a server type, while a false value represents a workstation type

      • getName

        public static OperatingSystem getName(java.lang.String osName)
        Returns the operating system enumeration value with the specified name, ignoring case. The name is the enum constant name, such as WIN2012R2 or WIN10.
        Parameters:
        osName - the abbreviated operating system name
        Returns:
        the matching operating system, or null if no match is found
        Throws:
        java.lang.NullPointerException - if osName is null

      • getNameExtended

        public static OperatingSystem getNameExtended(java.lang.String osName)
        Returns the first operating system enumeration value whose full real name contains a match for the specified regular expression, ignoring case.
        Parameters:
        osName - the regular expression to match against the full real names of the operating systems
        Returns:
        the first matching operating system, or null if no match is found
        Throws:
        java.lang.NullPointerException - if osName is null
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the regular expression has a syntax error
